segments.name: Cardio-metabolic diseases
segments.description: A late-stage biopharmaceutical company developing and, if approved, commercializing oral LDL-C lowering therapies for patients with cardiometabolic diseases.
segments.evidence: The Company has one operating segment and, therefore, one reportable segment, which comprises the discovery, development and commercialization of transformative therapies for cardio-metabolic diseases.

revenueModel.text: The company's only revenue to date comes from the Menarini License and Menarini Supply Agreement, under which its partner Menarini pays for rights to commercialize obicetrapib in Europe.
revenueModel.evidence: To date the Menarini License and the Menarini Supply Agreement have been the only source of revenue to the Company and all such revenues derive from Italy.
